SELECT 
    dbt_valid_to IS NULL as vt_null,
    coalesce(dbt_is_deleted, false) as del_flag,
    case when dbt_valid_to is null and coalesce(dbt_is_deleted, false) = false then true else false end as computed_is_current,
    is_current as stored_is_current,
    count(*) as cnt
FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_STAGED.STG_FSC_ACCOUNT
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
LIMIT 10
